nodes.description: address public owner declared in contract owned; holds the privileged address of the token contract.
mapping(address => uint256) balances in BasicToken; stores every account token balance.
uint256 totalSupply_ in BasicToken; stores the minted token supply.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) internal allowed in StandardToken; ERC20 allowance table.
string public constant name = "Mobi USD" token metadata.
string public constant symbol = "MUSD" token metadata.
uint8 public constant decimals = 8 token metadata.
uint256 public constant INITIAL_SUPPLY = 20000000 * 10**8, the genesis supply.
msg.sender: caller identity used as owner, as balance holder and as allowance owner/spender.
constructor() of owned: sets owner = msg.sender at deployment.
transferOwnership(address newOwner) onlyOwner: rewrites owner with an unvalidated address.
getOwned() onlyOwner view: returns the current owner.
SafeMath.mul(uint256 a, uint256 b): multiplication with overflow assert.
SafeMath.div(uint256 a, uint256 b): truncating division.
SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b): subtraction with underflow assert.
SafeMath.add(uint256 a, uint256 b): addition with overflow assert.
totalSupply() view: returns totalSupply_.
transfer(address _to, uint256 _value): SafeMath-checked transfer from msg.sender.
balanceOf(address _owner) view: returns balances[_owner].
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value): allowance-based transfer using SafeMath.
approve(address _spender, uint256 _value): sets allowance, requires zeroing the previous allowance.
allowance(address _owner, address _spender) view: returns the remaining allowance.
increaseApproval(address _spender, uint _addedValue): SafeMath-checked allowance increase.
decreaseApproval(address _spender, uint _subtractedValue): allowance decrease with oldValue cache.
mintToken(uint256 _value) onlyOwner: mints new supply, uses raw += without SafeMath.
constructor() of MobiToken: sets totalSupply_ and balances[msg.sender] to INITIAL_SUPPLY.
Unchecked arithmetic: totalSupply_ += _value inside mintToken (uint256 overflow possible).
Unchecked arithmetic: balances[msg.sender] += _value inside mintToken (uint256 overflow possible).
Access control weakness: owner = newOwner accepts address(0)/arbitrary contract, potentially bricking ownership.
